reviews.title: Timings are pretty much on the dot.
reviews.text: Really impressed, the timings of REM sleep recovery was spot on for me.

reviews.title: Best app for quitting
reviews.text: Thing that help me

reviews.title: Helped
reviews.text: I really appreciate how this app helped facilitate my recovery. I was able to prepare myself for symptoms week by week, and having the rationale explained behind my symptoms was nice to have. Thank you all for making this app. It is really helpful.

reviews.title: Underestimated at first
reviews.text: But I find myself staring at this app and the count up almost every time I have a craving. I also get a little kick out of reaching milestones & reading the science behind what is happening. It’s really helped me more than I thought. I laughed at the mention of an app keeping me accountable but this thing works.

reviews.title: Trust me it works
reviews.text: If you’re actually looking to quit, this is the best app you can get. It walks you through every awful symptom you’ll have in withdrawal

reviews.title: So grateful for this app.
reviews.text: Title says it all. I was in a years-long ditch and this app was the rope I used to climb out. I love its tracking and milestone features, which let me look back on it to see how far I’ve come. Thank you.

reviews.title: Exactly what I needed
reviews.text: Exactly what I was looking for. Tracks time and money milestones but also shows how your body is improving in several ways, and things to expect during different parts of the journey. Thank you.

reviews.title: Good
reviews.text: It work

reviews.title: Great App!
reviews.text: Surprisingly effective!

reviews.title: If you’re trying to quit, buy this app!
reviews.text: 10/10. Love all of the facts about what is happening to my body—it really helps me stay focused on my goal & motivated to achieve it. The customer service is phenomenal! Would highly recommend just buying the lifetime purchase. Thank you for creating the best quit weed app on the market!

reviews.title: Its a great app
reviews.text: I use it for T-Breaks and it shows you exactly where you are in your break, has all the science there so you can read it. For me my withdrawals are very minor. It’s very obvious the creator really cares about this, even the premium version is a one time payment and from isn’t too expensive. Good luck with whatever you use it for!!

reviews.title: same old abstinence only
reviews.text: first intro to the app is a tough love monologue that calls you by the identifier the app owner uses themself: weed addict. immediately off-putting abstinence only 1980s DARE take on substance use, disordered substance use, and substance use disorder. i will update this review if my opinion changes.

reviews.title: Been sober for over a year
reviews.text: I was wasting $30-$70 a day on weed. It’s really nice that you can plug in the numbers and see the amount of money you’ve actually saved. After being sober for over a year, I definitely see how weed can be addictive. Thank you to the developers of this simple but necessary app!

reviews.title: Quit Weed!!!
reviews.text: Quitting weed has changed my life, I don’t need the app anymore but I love to keep it to remind myself of how much progress I’ve made. Life is better sober enjoying your life and staying motivated for the things that really matter. Definitely use this to keep yourself on track, in the back of my head in the beginning it helped a lot.

reviews.title: Great and simple app
reviews.text: Easy to use. Informative. Encouraging as well. Recommend

reviews.title: Hold me accountable
reviews.text: As a 10 year smoker this helped me quit

reviews.title: Awesome!
reviews.text: obviously the app was better before the paywall. but i can honestly say it didn’t impact my user experience. the pro version is nice, but not necessary for this to be a useful tool.  it’s not like the app can quit for you, but it does help. being able to see how much money you’ve saved, while also seeing how you’re saving your body in the process is very important. i never thought i could do it, but over a year in i will say i still check the app occasionally to see how far i’ve come. overall awesome and i truly don’t think this app was created with anything but people’s best interest in heart.

reviews.title: It’s really helpful
reviews.text: 100% recommended

reviews.title: Awesome App
reviews.text: While this isn’t going to single handedly make you quit this is a great tool for tracking progress and helps ground yourself when cravings come around. Hitting new benchmarks genuinely feels rewarding and makes me want to keep going.

reviews.title: Great motivation to quit
reviews.text:
I was a daily nighttime spliff smoker for the last 2 years. I couldn’t imagine going to bed without having a spliff to relax. I knew i needed to stop relying on weed to sleep, but quitting seemed impossible. 

The badges, app design, and milestones make it easier. Whenever I have a craving at night, I open the app, look at my progress and read about the next milestones to keep my motivated. It’s amazing thank you so much for making this app!

reviews.title: Bummed about the changes to the detox counter
reviews.text: I love this app, but it’s almost like that painting of Jesus that went too far trying to make it perfect. The older countdown clocks where you could watch all the different milestones of your recovery was one of my favorite things about the app. Getting to see in real time how much further I had to go on certain things was part of the motivation. I wish that I had known it was gonna change fundamentally before I purchased.

reviews.title: Ads ads ads
reviews.text: Too much ads I used to use this app but now I can see ads app cheap

reviews.title: Great App
reviews.text: This app is so helpful! I highly recommend!!

reviews.title: This app helped me quit
reviews.text: I use this app in my journey to quit weed for good.

reviews.title: Monetizing Everything
reviews.text: I bought the lifetime version to get no ads and the additional info. Turns out they changed everything and I need to pay 17.99 more in order to get the services I already paid for

reviews.title: App used to be good now overrun with ads
reviews.text: Title says it all.  Now it’s barely useable.  Ads pop constantly.  No new innovation into the app just scammy pop ups every 30secs.  $4 a month pro version unlocks a few extra milestones but not worth the price.

reviews.title: From lonely, to not so lonely
reviews.text: This app has really helped me along my journey. My roommate is quitting with me, but he wasn’t a heavy user like myself. This app has really helped me in times of feeling alone with my struggles.

reviews.title: Too many ads!!
reviews.text: I just need a day counter to know how many days I’ve been clean. Had the app open for literally one minute and had two ads. No thanks. NEXT

reviews.title: Thank you
reviews.text: I’m so very grateful for this app and the motivation I got from it . Who ever made this deserves an award of some type. There are some fun things i thought of that would benefit this app. Maybe have the ability to unlock new themes , definitely add something pertaining to one’s sex drive , running , working out in general. Those things are definitely a factor. Again thank you so much for your work on this issue. And will continue to use this

reviews.title: Best quit apple
reviews.text: This app has really helped me and told me the how facts to help motivate me

reviews.title: Excellent app made obnoxious
reviews.text: An excellent app severely hampered by the fact you cannot go more than literally a minute without a pop up ad. Worth getting, but only to keep track of how long it’s been. A pity— there’s a lot of neat stuff, but I’ll never bother looking because I don’t want to be assaulted constantly by obnoxious pop ups every single minute.

reviews.title: Accountability for those who could use it
reviews.text:
This app is nothing ground breaking, but it can help change your life in a positive way. Good insights, milestones and tracking of some
Key metrics associated with quitting cannabis. It’s helped me, so It can likely help you. I purchased the year only because I wanted to support the developers in helping continue make content that may help others. Good luck to anyone on their journey

reviews.title: 3 year heavy user
reviews.text: I have been smoking heavy for 3 years. At first it was to mask the stress in my life but then slowly overtime it’s all I craved. If I wasn’t high I was miserable. I got used to be numb. Feeling nothing in life is dangerous. I lost drive and motivation to, live life to its fullest. I started getting sick every morning in what they call, “scrommiting”. My body was fighting against it but my craving for the high was too strong. One day I found this app. It breaks down each milestone giving you something to look forward to. I’m 6 days clean and I have never felt better. Here’s to the journey !

reviews.title: It’s good
reviews.text: It’s good to review how long you’ve gone without smoking and how much money you saved. It’s really nice. It’s a good grounding.

reviews.title: Wow! This is such a Brilliant app!
reviews.text: Thank you to the developer of this app. Thought of every unique detail! As much as cannabis is widely accepted now, it is still very addicting and often times debilitating. It’s fun to see how much money I saved the most ! LOL! Thank you again! Even the Free version still offers so much. Stay blessed everybody on their journey to sobriety and even cutting back less. We got this 💪🏽

reviews.title: Track your progress
reviews.text: Really great from tracking your progress

reviews.title: Gambling ads in a quitting app??
reviews.text: This app is wonderful and has helped me a lot in recovering and knowing how to manage quitting. Unfortunately it constantly feeds me ads for apps such as Kalshi and FanDuel, which is so incredibly slimy because it could cause someone to download it and start a brand new habit that they were trying to quit. Great tool, but do better.

reviews.title: Days summary is great
reviews.text: Great app!  Developer made it so you could total # of days!

reviews.title: Seriously Helped Me Through It.
reviews.text: Actually very helpful app, it's scary and feels shameful to admit if you become physically dependent on leaves. Having an app that can give you visual countdowns until you should start feeling better with descriptions? It's actually incredibly helpful. I think this app gave me a lot of motivation while I was initially drying out.. with semi severe symptoms of withdrawals. I'm almost a week clean, which is a lot more than I've been in a while. This app isn't one of those complete paywalls; it actually serves its purpose well. I would recommend, cheers to staying sober!

reviews.title: Very Helpful
reviews.text: This app has been very helpful putting things in perspective for me. I have used medical for a decade now and I have been a smoker for 20 years. I am on my fifth day completely cold turkey. I’m still having night sweats etc. but being able to keep track of my progress is amazing and this is a cool feature. I have a bunch of music that is all inspired by medicinal I have tattoos that are inspired by Mary Jane I am a Toker to the core I couldn’t go 24 hours without any Mary Jane that was my biggest fear in life, anyone that says that there isn’t withdrawals is completely lying I’m so happy to be off. I actually picked up some anxiety medicine. It has really helped and I feel a lot more calm and levelheaded than I have in years.

reviews.title: So Far So Good but
reviews.text: For the most part, this is a truly helpful app. The only thing I find a little confusing is the sub they send you to. Apparently not everybody there is trying to quit Quit Weed. So it can be a little triggering to try to navigate. I particularly like the scientific info that they give you. For the price it really can’t be beat.

reviews.title: Was a great app until
reviews.text: You guys started locking previously free things behind a paywall, this is to help people quit weed, why are you being greedy?

reviews.title: Tryingintulsa
reviews.text: The app is good but I wish more of the features were available for free

reviews.title: Plz go back to individual days instead of by months.
reviews.text: 2.3 months doesn’t hit as hard as 70 days!!! Pls add the option to change this

reviews.title: This app is so helpful.
reviews.text: Literally the only reason I was able to stay sober is because of this app. I do have the paid version but it’s so worth it. It’s such a good positive reinforcement to be able to see how much money I’ve saved and how much I’ve avoided. Also, the feature where it goes through the health symptoms is important because I know that if I relapse, I start all over again with symptoms, and I don’t wanna go through the symptoms again.

reviews.title: Very helpful
reviews.text: Well thought out. It’s free. Nice to see progress and the benefits.

reviews.title: Day one
reviews.text: Honestly pretty cool concept, I think there should be more rewards and achievements. Though I do only have the free version. How cool would it be to win a free meal from a local fast food place for achieving the 30 day mark ect. Other than that. I’m using it and tracking my savings by not smoking. I’m sure developers will update more stuff. For now, great app still

reviews.title: Not for people who are just looking for mindfulness
reviews.text: I was really excited about this app. Unfortunately the founders need to push this as addiction only makes me uncomfortable. I have had to use cannabis since I was 16 for medical issues that no prescription drugs can help without serious side effects. I am looking to modify my intake to just edibles and put more control around my usage to see how it makes me feel. I want to do this without being told I’m an addict or made to feel negative towards cannabis. It’s fully fine if someone wants to quit for a period and then use again. The intro to this app is very divisive and for that reason I don’t recommend it unless you feel like you are an addict and are comfortable with that framing.
